description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/mpas/rules/fv_laplacian_cell -- the mimetic div-of-grad composition on the unstructured grid: the TRiSK discrete Laplacian as a connectivity-based stencil via the ragged edges_of_cell index set (like fv_divergence_cell) with the edge flux built in-place from phi and dcEdge (like fv_gradient_edge) instead of read from a declared edge field. Every binding loads fixture.esm (metaparameters folded at the import edge to the level-0 mesh sizes), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST for the model: laplacian(phi) replaced by the ragged finite-volume aggregate (output over cells, contracted k over edges_of_cell with the nEdgesOnCell/edgesOnCell offsets/values factors, each summand the outward-signed edge-normal gradient flux edgeSignOnCell*dvEdge*(phi[c2]-phi[c1])/dcEdge over areaCell), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
